pages.title: Degenerate Matter Chunk
pages.text: Matter so compressed that its electrons are packed into every available quantum state, held up only by the Pauli exclusion principle. It is the stuff of white dwarf cores, and a lump the size of a walnut weighs more than I would care to carry. It is faintly warm, utterly rigid, and refuses to be scratched by anything I own.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Letting a Pocket Universe run long in the Universe Forge, I found its first stars had already lived and died. Sifting the remains, I pulled out the cinders of their cores: electron-degenerate, still dense enough to dent the forge tray.

Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Degenerate Matter Ore$(), in veins through the End.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Casimir Effect.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Block of Neutronium, Bounce Core, Liquid Metallic Hydrogen, Neutrino Flux, Protostar Core, Sterile Neutrino, Strange Matter, Strange Matter Pellet and more.
